parts.text: Name the **two** types of covalent bond in the structure in Fig. 3.1.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text:
The primary structure of lysozyme is shown in Fig. 3.1.
Explain the meaning of the term *primary structure*.

parts.label: (b)
parts.stem: Lysozyme hydrolyses the $\beta$-1,4 glycosidic bonds present in compounds found in bacterial cell walls.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.text: State what is meant by the term *hydrolysis*.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: Suggest the type of biological molecule which is the substrate for lysozyme.

parts.label: (b)(iii)
parts.text:
Lysozyme uses the induced fit mechanism.
Explain the mode of action of an enzyme that uses the induced fit mechanism.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
In human tears and saliva, lysozyme acts as an extracellular enzyme.
State what is meant by the term *extracellular*.
